description: Natural-language search over the code: describe behavior ("where is retry backoff implemented", "function that validates auth tokens") rather than symbol names. Hybrid keyword+embedding ranking, fully local. First-ever call downloads the embedding model (~150 MB one-time); until embedding coverage completes, results are keyword-weighted and say so.

cursor.description: continuation token from a truncated response; repeat the same arguments with it

max_tokens.description: soft cap on response size in estimated tokens; truncated output says how to get the rest

query.description: what the code does, in plain language

name: semantic_search
title: Semantic code search
